purpose: City parcel geometry and registry/cadastre research; local registry evidence and publicly retrievable vector geometry are assessed independently.
name: Irapuato

queries.query: Irapuato Mexico official cadastral map land registry parcel GIS
queries.result: Found the official municipal GeoPortal, which describes itself as Irapuato's spatial-data infrastructure and advertises a parcel-oriented land-use system (SIUS) and fiscal-value map. The official municipal digital-services pages also identify Dirección de Catastro and cadastral certificate procedures. No anonymous parcel-vector schema or public geometry response was exposed in the bounded review.

queries.query: Irapuato mapa catastral oficial predios catastro GIS
queries.result: La búsqueda en español identificó el Geoportal oficial del Municipio de Irapuato, el Sistema de Información de Uso de Suelo (SIUS), y la Ventanilla de Constancia de Certificación Catastral. SIUS permite buscar por domicilio, cuenta predial, clic en el mapa o ubicación geográfica, pero la página indica que se debe iniciar sesión; la ventanilla también requiere iniciar sesión. No se verificó un servicio anónimo de geometría parcelaria ni se solicitaron datos personales o de titularidad.

officialSources.operator: Municipio de Irapuato, Dirección de Tecnologías de la Información y Geomática
officialSources.observation: Official GeoPortal identifies itself as the municipal spatial-data infrastructure and lists interactive spatial tools. It advertises Libro de Valores Fiscales and SIUS, but the indexed landing page does not expose service URLs, layer schema, CRS, or parcel geometry.
officialSources.scope: Municipal Irapuato spatial-data portal; registry/cadastral context, not verified public vector access.

officialSources.operator: Municipio de Irapuato, Dirección General de Desarrollo Urbano
officialSources.observation: Official SIUS page says the system can search land-use information by address, predial account, map click, or geographic location, and explicitly displays 'Iniciar Sesión'. No anonymous safe feature response was available.
officialSources.scope: Municipal parcel/land-use viewer advertised by the city; access is login-gated in the reviewed public page.

officialSources.observation: Official cadastral-certification portal describes a cadastral certificate containing identifying, quantitative, qualitative, geographic and fiscal elements, but requires account login and applicant documentation. No login or personal-data submission was attempted.
officialSources.scope: Local cadastral custodian and procedure evidence; not anonymous geometry access.

officialSources.observation: Official municipal service information identifies Dirección de Catastro as responsible for obtaining a cadastral key and routes applicants to the municipal VCCC platform, with document requirements. This confirms local cadastral custody but does not provide an open parcel API.
